top_signals.title: Tech Trade May See Bigger Retail Influence After July Rout, JPMorgan Says
top_signals.summary: The technology trade may be poised to become even more dependent on retail investors and more volatile after a rough July, according to an assessment of preliminary data on technology, media and telecommunications equity sector hedge funds from JPMorgan Chase & Co.
